lanes.capability: Choose trainee, venue, and fight, rotate, heal, or stop actions from completion, party, resource, and risk state.
lanes.cheapest_falsifier: Fit once on the 22 complete joined scale-train questions and compare the existing baseline with the frozen update on only the five newly completed, never-scored development questions.

latest_reorientation.authority_delta: The recovery added nine measured outcome questions but fit no model and granted no authority. The eight-question outcome model remains the development baseline; live party-development authority remains zero.
latest_reorientation.blocker: Five successor trials remain invalid, leaving two train and one development questions censored. They do not block the 22-train plus five-newly-completed-development learner falsifier; the remaining uncertainty is whether the larger, more diverse outcome set improves the model.
latest_reorientation.decision: Stop repairing teacher mechanics. Authenticate and fit one fixed candidate on the 22 complete joined scale-train questions, exclude all six previously scored development questions, and compare once on only the five newly completed labels. Retain for a later shadow design only if paired updated wins exceed base wins, accuracy does not decrease, cross-entropy decreases, and mean winner probability increases; every mixed result requires learner redesign before more data.
latest_reorientation.learning_output: The immutable recovery successor measured 10 of the 15 previously invalid candidate trials. This completed four additional train and five additional development questions, advancing cumulative evidence to 30/32 train and 15/16 development while retaining five invalid trials and three censored questions honestly.
latest_reorientation.next_falsifier: One published offline runner must authenticate the 88 measured plus five invalid joined denominator, train only on 22 complete scale-train questions, exclude six previously observed development questions, and compare once on five newly completed, never-scored development labels.
latest_reorientation.next_session_goal: Publish the fail-closed joined fitter, require green exact-head CI, execute one offline fit and newly completed-label comparison, then adjudicate the learner before any more collection or teacher work.
latest_reorientation.product_alignment: The recovered collection, evolution, balance and role-coverage choices are identity-free outcome evidence for deciding how to develop a party. That skill is required to evolve and retain a living Pokedex across titles, while the bounded comparison prevents Red teacher reliability from becoming the product.
latest_reorientation.stop_condition: Treat the candidate as failed if paired updated wins do not exceed base wins, accuracy falls, cross-entropy does not fall, mean winner probability does not rise, or the metrics are mixed. Preserve that result and do not run another recovery campaign, promote, open sealed Red, or execute Crystal.
latest_reorientation.transfer_result: Not run. Crystal remains closed until the Red outcome representation produces a clear development gain and earns a title-neutral shadow-transfer design.

learned_authority.current: One eight-question outcome-trained development baseline and one rejected 26-question candidate exist; the recovery adds data but no model or live authority.
learned_authority.target: Fit a candidate on 22 complete joined scale-train questions, pass the frozen descriptive rule on five newly completed, never-scored development labels, then evaluate its recommendations in goal-manager shadow mode before any authority or Crystal probe.

lanes.name: Repeatable completion-aware party outcome learning
lanes.next_decision: After one 22-question train-only fit and one five-question newly completed-label comparison, either retain the candidate for goal-manager shadow integration or stop collection and redesign the learner.
stop_conditions: The 22-question train-only update cannot pass the frozen descriptive rule on five newly completed, never-scored Red development labels.
Another recovery or teacher-repair campaign is proposed before the current learner result identifies missing data as the bottleneck.
Any apparent gain comes from overleveling, teacher labels, identity leakage, fixed-route knowledge, or stale direct-combat evidence.
Infrastructure work exceeds the maintenance budget without unblocking a measured learning output.
lanes.transfer_test: Use the same identity-free state and action contract on an unseen Crystal development slice and compare Red initialization with zero initialization.

lanes.name: One-shot 14-question party outcome campaign
lanes.reason: Its provenance cost and non-retryable failures dominate the learning signal, so it is no longer the development leading edge.

product.environment_role: Red is the first curriculum and Crystal is the first transfer test; neither title is the product.
product.goal: Build a transferable Pokemon agent that can finish stories and create a living Pokedex across mainline games, versions, trades, and legitimate event inputs.
non_goals: A perfect fixed Pokemon Red walkthrough.
An overleveled teacher replay that removes the decisions the model should learn.
Process, provenance, or CI evidence without measured learner outcomes.
A separate hand-scripted teacher for every game.
success_conditions: Complete each title's story and supported mechanics under declared learned authority.
Acquire, retain, evolve, and trade every legitimately obtainable species required by the living collection contract.
Transfer shared navigation, battle, party, resource, planning, and collection knowledge into later titles with less teaching.
Explain version, trade, event, one-shot, and unsupported-mechanic blockers without fabricating availability.

review_roles.antigravity: Challenge architecture and cross-game transfer at milestone decisions, with at most three falsifiable claims and explicit work to delete.
review_roles.claude: Audit frozen benchmark or sealed designs, statistics, leakage, and claims; routine development does not wait for a forensic review.
review_roles.codex: Own implementation, measurement, adjudication, documentation, publication, and the active-lane counter.

benchmark.purpose: Freeze a meaningful comparison or authority gate after development has produced a signal.

development.purpose: Generate diverse outcomes, fit models, falsify ideas, and iterate quickly on non-sealed scenarios.

sealed.purpose: Protect a one-shot claim whose result cannot be tuned, replaced, or retried.

status_report.counter_source: Tracked path-free evidence only; inputs, preflights, CI passes, and teacher runs do not advance learning counters.
